label: Restaurant Wolfslaar
method: One read-only attempt per URL through the existing safe fetch (SSRF guards, redirect limit, timeout and byte cap). Bytes are stored under the gitignored ops/benchmark/output/card-captures/; only SHA-256, size, content type, role and time are committed here. A readable page without menu content is recorded as not-a-menu, an unreadable page as blocked. The decimalAmountCount per capture only counts amounts printed with a decimal part; a whole-euro menu (Wolfslaar) therefore reports 0 and the reference, not this counter, proves its prices.

authorization.decision: Product Owner 2026-10-21, option 1 (four existing cards plus an unseen set), reference GitHub #59 issuecomment-6315226470; Delivery Lead order review 6315269210.
authorization.scope: Public read-only comparison of exactly these four existing-card sources and the menu sub-pages/PDFs that the historical data/menus.json export itself names. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, other restaurant, arbitrary crawl, publication, production write or app-side AI.

previousCardCapture.note: The 2026-10-21 capture of this source failed. Review 6349832755 K1 is the one honest read-only re-attempt; these bytes are pinned for the first time.

limitations: One read-only attempt per URL through the existing safe fetch; robots.txt is not consulted by this benchmark capture route, exactly like the accepted Bardot capture.

Only the pinned entry URL, the menu URLs the historical export names, the pinned probe URLs and the same-host menu links the entry page itself names (one hop). No crawl, no alternative URL, no other location.
A readable page that is not a menu is recorded as not-a-menu; an unreadable page as blocked. Neither is ever counted as a menu.
